description: This file provides utility functions for generating deterministic colors based on strings or statuses, primarily used for UI elements to visually distinguish categories or statuses with consistent colors in a dark-themed dashboard.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Generates a deterministic pastel HSL color string from an input string, ensuring distinct hues for different strings with consistent saturation and lightness.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a given status or category string to a themed color, falling back to a deterministic color if the status is unknown or unrecognized.
